item.title: Budget 2027 Omits NCD Control, Health Workforce Reforms
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
The Galen Centre says regularising existing doctors with permanent positions doesn't increase the actual number of HCPs. Budget 2027 omitted a multi-year recruitment and retention programme. item.title: Government Abolishes Madani Medical Scheme Under Budget 2027
item.description:

item.title: Budget 2027: Health Ministry Gets RM47.7b, Smallest Increase In Five Years
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)

item.title: Sabah Loses Over 240 Doctors, 64% No-Shows Among Postings From Outside Sabah
item.description:
